-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #0 / Scene #83 - Function H_Phindous
function H_Phindous()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town001D.fld")
	MoveCamera(0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	RotCamera(0.00, 1.57, 100.00)

	CreateObject(0, 10001, 740.00, 730.00, 192, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(1, 10003, 730.00, 730.00, 64, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayCameraNoWait("H_Phindous_01.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	wait(4000)
	OpenTalkScene(69, 11)
	PlayCameraNoWait("H_Phindous_02.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	WalkObject(0, 800.000000, 760.000000, 0.000000, 1, 4, 2)
	wait(3500)
	OpenTalkScene(69, 12)
	PlayCameraNoWait("H_Phindous_03.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	RotateObject(1, 0, 1)
	OpenTalkScene(69, 13)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(H_Phindous)
